name: Cufflinks & Cages
source:
Dani works in an office that supplies Chastity Cages. A law was passed that forced all people deemed hypersexual to enforced chastity. So the company exploded overnight. All employee's are assessed to not be hypersexual before being hired. However Dani somehow managed to get hired without being noticed.

Sofia knows Dani is Hypersexual, and is sadistically keeping her in chastity with the hopes of making her a personal pet. Sofia keeps Dani busy doing humiliating tasks. Will Dani be able to make it through each day?
